title: Built by People. Defined by Detail.
intro: Custom Sign Forge brings design, technical knowledge and hands-on fabrication together to make signs around your brand.

hero.alt: Skilled fabricators working on custom metal lettering in the workshop
hero.caption: Hands-on lettering fabrication

team.alt: Design and project staff reviewing artwork at their workstations
team.caption: Artwork, technical details and project communication

teamIntro: Designers, technical craftspeople and production staff bring different skills to the same project. Our senior technical craftspeople have more than a decade of sign-making experience.

roles.title: Design & Technical Planning
roles.text: We work through your artwork, proportions, material and lighting to develop the details for production.

roles.title: Skilled Fabrication
roles.text: Cutting, forming, welding and surface finishing turn the approved design into physical lettering and logos.

roles.title: Checks & Project Communication
roles.text: Our team follows the specification through assembly, appearance checks, packing and shipment preparation.

capabilities.title: Cut & Shape
capabilities.text: Laser cutting and engraving define the lettering, panels and details around your artwork.
capabilities.alt: Cutting and engraving equipment used for sign components
capabilities.caption: Cutting & engraving

capabilities.title: Build & Finish
capabilities.text: Letter returns, joints and surface treatments give the sign its structure and visible character.
capabilities.alt: Metal letter return with formed edges and surface detail
capabilities.caption: Construction & surface detail

capabilities.title: Assemble & Illuminate
capabilities.text: Faces, returns, fixings and lighting are brought together for the agreed sign configuration.
capabilities.alt: LED modules arranged inside a dimensional metal letter
capabilities.caption: Lighting & assembly

quality.title: Appearance & Assembly
quality.text: Check the dimensions, surfaces, edges and assembled details against the agreed specification.

quality.title: Lighting & Function
quality.text: Review illumination and the applicable order checks for the selected configuration.

quality.title: Protection for Shipment
quality.text: Prepare protective materials and packing around the sign components and shipment arrangements.

check.alt: Gloved craftsperson examining a sign component
check.caption: Surface and component checks

packing.alt: Finished sign components being protected inside a shipment crate
packing.caption: Packing finished lettering

closing: From a single shopfront to a coordinated commercial project, start with your logo, space and ideas. We will work through the sign style, specification and quote with you.
